# Kashmir EcoWatch Western Himalayan (KEW)

> Independent, non-commercial, non-political scientific environmental intelligence platform documenting hydrological systems, alpine lakes, Ramsar wetlands, glaciers, biodiversity, pollution telemetry, natural hazards, and environmental governance across Kashmir and the Western Himalaya.

- **Official Name:** Kashmir EcoWatch
- **Extended Institutional Identity:** Kashmir EcoWatch Western Himalayan (KEW)
- **Historical Lineage:** Established 2004 as Environment and Service Research Organization (ESRO)
- **Canonical Website:** https://kashmir-ecowatch.com
- **Canonical Entity ID:** https://kashmir-ecowatch.com/#organization
- **Institutional Support:** Dr. Kumar Foundation USA & Kumar Trust USA
- **Geographical Scope:** Western Himalaya (Kashmir Valley, Jammu, Ladakh, Azad Jammu & Kashmir, Gilgit-Baltistan)
- **Open Data License:** Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) unless otherwise noted
- **Scientific Contact:** contact@kashmir-ecowatch.com
